policy.description:
Divini Homines 12, 0035 [November 22, 2025]

Prohibition of Stablecoin Issuance and/or Use to Safeguard Financial Stability, Investor Protection and Monetary Sovereignty.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Grand Rising, Everyone. 

Happy Divini Homines 12, 0035, also known as November 22, 2025. Different timeline. 

You can see how fast my hair has grown since my last haircut, just so many days ago. 

Here now is the Royal Decree issued by Her Royal Majesty Queen Romana Didulo The First, Queen and Commander-in-Chief of The Kingdom of Canada and The World, Living Crown Custodian of Earth and Humanity, Commander-in-Chief of United Armies of Earth under Natural Law. 

Dates November 22, 2025. 

Royal Decree name, Prohibition of Stablecoin Issuance and/or Use to Safeguard Financial Stability, Investor Protection and Monetary Sovereignty. 

Whereas stablecoins despite their name, have demonstrated significant volatility and systemic risk, as evidenced by the collapse of algorithmic stable points, such as TerraUSD, also known as UST, in year 2022. 

These digital assets introduce risks to The Kingdom of Canada's financial system, including run risks, lack of transparency and threats to monetary sovereignty. The Kingdom of Canada's Securities Administrators and The Kingdom of Canada's Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions have identified these risks as critical and have called for strict regulatory oversight. 

Now, therefore, I, Her Royal Majesty Queen Romana, Didulo The First, hereby issue under Natural Law this Decree. 

1] Prohibition of Stablecoin Issuance. 

It is hereby prohibited to issue, operate, or facilitate the use of any stablecoin within the jurisdiction of The Kingdom of Canada. This includes both algorithmic and fiat-backed currency stablecoins, as both present significant risks to financial stability and investor protection. 

2] Ban on Stablecoin Transactions. 

Financial institutions in The Kingdom of Canada, payment service providers, and digital asset platform, platforms operating within The Kingdom of Canada are prohibited from facilitating transactions involving stablecoins. This includes the exchange, transfer, or storage of stablecoins on Canadian soil or through The Kingdom of Canada Canadian-based services. 

3] Monetary Sovereignty and Policy Integrity. 

I, Her Royal Majesty Queen Romana Didulo The First, under Natural Law, reaffirms the role of the National Treasury of The Kingdom of Canada in monetary policy. The use of stablecoins, particularly those pegged to foreign currencies, undermines the Treasury's ability to manage the economy effectively. 

Therefore, I, Her Royal Majesty, Queen Romana Didulo The First of The Kingdom of Canada, will take all necessary measures to ensure that The Kingdom of Canada dollar, backed by gold and silver, remains the primary medium of exchange and store of value within The Kingdom of Canada. 

4] Investor Protection and Transparency. 

The prohibition of stablecoins is intended to protect Canadian Nationals, investors from the risk of unregulated financial instruments, lack of transparency, and lack of recourse in the event of failure. 

5] Enforcement and Compliance. 

The Kingdom of Canada's Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions, The Kingdom of Canada's Securities Administrators, and other relevant regulatory Bodies under Natural Law are authorized to enforce the Decree and take necessary actions to ensure compliance. 

Violations of this Royal Decree will result in legal criminal consequences, including fines, penalties, or revocation of operating licenses and or imprisonment.

This Royal Decree is effective immediately, Signed, Her Royal Majesty Queen Romana Didulo The First. November 22, 2025.
